name: Ear Collector
description: This sword collects an [brown]ear[/brown] stack to identify each of its victims, and upon exiting combat may attract a wandering guild trader who provides [effect:items][dark-gray]items[/dark-gray][/effect] in exchange for its [brown]ears[/brown].

effects.explanation: Wares include useful combat items, gems, rare gear, and other unique offers.
